title: Import items from a JSON file

titleLocal.fra: Importer des produits depuis un fichier JSON

description: Reads a JSON file uploaded by the user directly from an XSLT 3.0 stylesheet (json-to-xml over unparsed-text), builds the Data Factory items XML document and imports it into the PL_DEMO_PRODUCTS table.

descriptionLocal.fra: Lit un fichier JSON déposé par l'utilisateur directement depuis une feuille XSLT 3.0 (json-to-xml sur unparsed-text), construit le document XML des items Data Factory et l'importe dans la table PL_DEMO_PRODUCTS.

userInputs.title: JSON file
userInputs.description: An array of objects with identifiers, classification and fields maps (see tests/input-example.json)

tasks.name: file-transformation-xslt
tasks.description: Build the items document from the JSON file. The stylesheet runs on a dummy source (empty.xml) and reads the uploaded file through its jsonFile parameter

tasks.name: table-import-items
tasks.description: Create or update the items of the PL_DEMO_PRODUCTS table
